archetype: Neo-Brutalist Pop (Fun, Colorful, Playful - Hype Drop Vibe)

headings.guideline: Use for all large text, hero sections, and numbers. Extremely wide, heavy, and punchy.

body.guideline: Use for product descriptions, functional UI, and manifesto body text.

colors.guideline: Avoid gradients. Use solid blocks of primary colors with thick borders to create a comic/pop-art tactile feel.

motion.hero_reveal: Staggered line-by-line reveal. Wrap each text line in an overflow-hidden div, and animate the inner text from translateY(100%) to translateY(0%) with a custom cubic-bezier(0.76, 0, 0.24, 1).
motion.hover_states: Hover on cards/buttons should translate-x-[-2px] translate-y-[-2px] and expand the drop shadow. Active states should translate to 0 and remove the shadow completely (press effect).
motion.scroll_animations: Use framer-motion whileInView to trigger staggered fade-up and scale-in (0.95 to 1.0) on grid items.
motion.parallax: Use framer-motion useScroll to slightly translate Y the hero images relative to scroll position.

layouts.hero: Kinetic layout. H1 typography covers the screen. A central 3D/floating box image interacts with mouse movement (use framer-motion useTransform).
layouts.categories_bento: Tetris Grid: 12-column CSS grid. Span items asymmetrically (e.g. Gamer Box: col-span-8, Snack Box: col-span-4). Use thick gap (gap-6).
layouts.pricing: 3-column flex or grid. The ₹599 Premium tier should scale(1.05) by default, colored in striking Yellow, while others are Pink and Cyan.
layouts.manifesto: Numbered list layout (01, 02, 03). Massive numbers using the accent colors, left-aligned text.
layouts.golden_box: Inverted section. Background black (#09090B). Text white. Use glowing gold accents and a ticking countdown timer for hype.

component_guidelines.button: Pill shaped (rounded-full). Padding: py-4 px-8. Border: 2px solid #09090B. Shadow: brutal. Text: uppercase, bold, tracking-wider.
component_guidelines.card: Solid color background, rounded-2xl, border-2 or border-4 solid #09090B. Inner padding should be generous (p-6 or p-8). Image should be masked with rounded-xl inside.
component_guidelines.marquee: Slow editorial marquee. 100vw width, 2px border top and bottom. High contrast text reading 'EVERY BOX. A NEW SURPRISE.' repeated.

accessibility.data_testid_rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
accessibility.contrast: Maintain 4.5:1 ratio. Dark text on neon/bright backgrounds is mandatory. Do not use white text on yellow or pink.
accessibility.transparency: DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays, dropdowns, or headers where content sits underneath.

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Implement an Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level experience. Emphasize scarcity and hype-drop mechanics (countdowns, large bold typography).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center-align the app container. No generic SaaS styling.
Use 2-3x more padding than usual to give the design breathing room.
Every button and card must have a micro-interaction (scale or brutalist press effect).
Import fonts in index.css or via Google Fonts in HTML head.
Do not use AI emojis. Use @phosphor-icons/react (duotone or bold) instead.
Build standard HTML/Tailwind for the landing page visual sections; use Shadcn for forms, dialogs, checkout flow.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL buttons, links, and forms.
